parameters.query: WITH done AS (UPDATE sports_radar.alert_jobs SET state='done',updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=$1::bigint AND owner=$2::text AND state='processing' RETURNING event_id,kind) SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM sports_radar.alert_deliveries d JOIN done j USING(event_id,kind) WHERE d.state='error') AS failed_deliveries;

parameters.jsCode: if(Number($input.first().json.failed_deliveries)>0)throw new Error('Some Telegram event alerts failed. Inspect sports_radar.alert_deliveries; failed or uncertain sends are not automatically retried to avoid duplicates.'); return $input.all();

parameters.query: UPDATE sports_radar.alert_jobs SET state=$3::text,payload=$4::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=$1::bigint AND owner=$2::text AND state='processing' RETURNING job_id,state,payload->>'reason' AS reason;

parameters.jsCode: const c=$input.first().json; if(c.state==='failed')throw new Error(c.reason||'Event alert could not be verified.'); return $input.all();
